parameters.content:
## Plan outdoor bookings around weather and generate a call-sheet video

### How it works
For small production teams coordinating outdoor sessions. Read approved booking requests and confirmed reservations, then assign non-overlapping daytime slots around rain, wind and temperature limits. Higher priorities go first; each request keeps its preferred time, moves, or is deferred. Produce a call-sheet video, decision CSV and tentative calendar file. Proposals do not book a calendar or invite attendees. Accepted jobs resume before new source requests; completed keys are not rendered again.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Configure **Zvid API** using [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets. Select **Outdoor Bookings** for the input nodes and **Weather Briefings** for recovery. Log headers: RenderKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, PlanJson, VideoUrl, CompletedAt.
4. Input headers: BookingId, Date, Title, Status, Approval, EarliestStart, LatestEnd, PreferredStart, DurationMinutes, Priority, Start, End. Approve requested rows; confirmed rows block Start–End. Set city, region, timezone and planningDate.
5. **dryRun=false spends credits** after eligibility. true returns JSON, quote and review files without writes or rendering. Set maxCreditsPerVideo.
6. Run one execution at a time. Review **Watch video → Binary → data → View** before sharing. Read the [companion guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/daily-weather-video.md) for field rules and migration.

### Customization
Adjust planning thresholds and priorities; increment forecastRevision for a deliberately revised call sheet.

nodes.name: 1. Choose source rules and schedule

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose source rules and schedule

Complete the overview setup and source contract. Run one execution at a time. Use the manual trigger before enabling the schedule.

nodes.name: 2. Recover accepted work before source checks

parameters.content:
## 2. Recover accepted work before source checks

Resume saved paid jobs even if the upstream source is unavailable. A preview never resumes a paid job.

nodes.name: 3. Read the booking desk

parameters.content:
## 3. Read the booking desk

Read approved requests and confirmed reservations for planningDate. Require offset-bearing times, duration, priority and stable BookingId. Keep confirmed bookings unchanged.

nodes.name: 4. Propose slots around forecast constraints

parameters.content:
## 4. Propose slots around forecast constraints

Allocate slots by priority without overlapping confirmed bookings or each other. Keep, reschedule or defer each request. Use daylight, temperature, rain and wind constraints.

nodes.name: 5. Continue only when the plan is eligible

parameters.content:
## 5. Continue only when the plan is eligible

Empty input, completed work, missing approval and blocked history return an explicit report. They spend no render credits.

nodes.name: 6. Recover accepted work before a new render

parameters.content:
## 6. Recover accepted work before a new render

Saved jobs follow the upper route using their original review context. New work continues through optional media and the domain design.

nodes.name: 7. Check optional background music

parameters.content:
## 7. Check optional background music

A failed or oversized music file is skipped. Empty musicUrl continues without an external request. This check preserves the selected source plan.

nodes.name: 8. Compose the booking decisions and confirmation steps

parameters.content:
## 8. Compose the booking decisions and confirmation steps

Branch on whether tentative slots exist. Build a booking-specific call sheet or a deferral briefing. The calendar file contains proposals only and never sends invitations.

nodes.name: 9. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

parameters.content:
## 9. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

dryRun=true returns the source plan, design JSON and quote. It performs no log writes, editor draft creation, render, or delivery.

nodes.name: 10. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

parameters.content:
## 10. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

Save the key and accepted job ID. Retry explicit capacity rejections up to three attempts, respecting the server delay and a 30-second minimum. Uncertain submissions require inspection. Sheets is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 11. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

parameters.content:
## 11. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

Poll the saved job within the deadline. Keep failed, timed-out and uncertain job IDs for inspection. Completed keys are skipped on later runs.

nodes.name: 12. Review the video and source-specific handoff

parameters.content:
## 12. Review the video and source-specific handoff

Completed renders reach Watch video → Binary → data → View. A failed render stops with its actual reason after saving the tracking row. Download the review CSV and check source facts before sharing.
